exposure: Gestational age at diagnosis of GDM
cohort: 151 pregnant women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) according to the Diabetes in Pregnancy Study Group of India criteria.
finding: Gestational age at diagnosis of GDM ≥33.28 weeks, maternal BMI ≥24.7 kg/m^2, and 75g OGTT value ≥162 mg/dL were predictors of antenatal insulin requirement.
